name: Rippa's Snarlfangs
inspire:
After a Power step, if a friendly fighter is equipped with 2 or more Upgrades, Inspire that fighter.

After a friendly fighter Attacks again as a result of the Snarlfang's Jaws Weapon ability, if that Attack is successful, Inspire that fighter.

reactions.name: Snarlfang's Jaws
reactions.rulesText:
If a friendly fighter's weapon has the {icon:snarlfangs-jaws} runemark, you have access to the following Weapon ability:

Snarlfang's Jaws {icon:snarlfangs-jaws}: After a successful or drawn Attack, the attacker can immediately Attack again using the relevant weapon below. These weapons cannot be modified.

If the attacker is Uninspired, use this weapon:

{icon:melee} {icon:hex} 1 {icon:hammer} 1 {icon:damage} 2

If the attacker is Inspired, use this weapon:

{icon:melee} {icon:hex} 1 {icon:swords} 2 {icon:damage} 2

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Rippa and his cronies might not get along, but they're no strangers to ganging up on prey.
abilities.rulesText: Pick an enemy fighter. Push each friendly fighter 1 hex closer to that fighter. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Smell Weakness
abilities.flavorText: Both grots and Snarlfangs love picking on the weak; in tandem, they make a vicious combination.
abilities.rulesText: In the next turn, rolls of {icon:flanked} and {icon:surrounded} do not count as successes in Attack rolls or Save rolls for enemy fighters adjacent to any friendly fighters. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Duck and Dive
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly fighter is picked to be the target of an Attack.
abilities.flavorText: Call it luck, call it agility - either way, it's saved Rippa and his crew more than once.
abilities.rulesText: Save rolls made for that fighter for that Attack count as having more {icon:crit} than the Attack roll for the purposes of Stand Fast. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Three grot riders on Snarlfangs with moderate health, a single shield save and average Move that rises to 5 with dodge saves once Inspired. Every weapon carries Snarlfang's Jaws, so a successful or drawn Attack triggers a bonus 2-damage bite, and landing that follow-up Inspires the fighter. Once-per-game tricks push the whole pack towards a chosen victim and stop enemies counting flanked or surrounded results. The warband wins through coordinated pile-ons, chaining double attacks to delete isolated targets quickly.
